$comment: Pins for site/vendor/ (ADR 2026-08-08-0450, 2026-08-08-0546). tools/vendor_check.py reads this file and fails the commit if a vendored file drifts from it, or if a file under site/vendor/ is missing here. Re-vendoring a library is a deliberate edit to this file plus the bytes it points at, in the same commit, with NOTICE updated alongside.

maplibre-gl.note: True ESM: package.json 'module'/'exports' both point at dist/maplibre-gl.mjs, which statically imports dist/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs and, at runtime, constructs a URL to dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs (relative to import.meta.url) to start its Worker. All three plus the CSS are the minimum load set — the shipped .d.ts is a type-checker input, not a browser runtime file, so it is not vendored.

pmtiles.note: NOT true ESM in practice, despite package.json declaring 'module': dist/esm/index.js. That file carries a bare specifier `import ... from "fflate"`, which only resolves under a bundler or an import map — neither is available here (no npm at runtime, no CDN, no second undeclared dependency). dist/pmtiles.js is the package's own documented browser answer (its README ships it as a plain <script src> global, `window.pmtiles`) and is a self-contained global build with fflate inlined: no bare imports, verified by grepping the file for import(/require(/from" specifiers. Vendored that file instead of the nominal ESM entry; loaded via a classic (non-module) <script> tag, not `import`.
